name: Silver
detailed_description:
The villagers from One Night Ultimate Werewolf once again find their humble home Town of Silver infested with werewolves! Compete with other mayors to have the fewest werewolves in your village. Harness each villager’s unique abilities in this fast and clever deduction card game.

FEATURES

⏺ Online Multiplayer

Connect with friends and family in private online games or with fellow gamers around the world in open online multiplayer, and compete with any number of ruthless AI opponents. The host player's purchased expansions are available to play with others in private online games.

⏺ Single Player Mode

With dynamic speed settings to suit all needs and ruthless AI adversaries, single player games provide a realistic challenge for new and experienced gamers alike.

⏺ Deck Customization

Explore and experience over 4 TRILLION possible Silver decks via downloadable digital content based on the pre-existing standalone Silver card game expansions.

⏺ Custom Decks Online

Save and share your custom decks in online multiplayer. Race to explore and exploit hidden combos hiding in every customized deck of Silver.

⏺ Immersive Experience

Every gaming moment has been brought to life with eccentric character design, atmospheric music, and sleek 3D animations, deeply immersing you in the One Night Ultimate Werewolf universe.

⏺ Strategic Gameplay

Each of Silver’s 4 TRILLION possible decks presents fresh challenges and powerful combos, making Silver a joy to explore. Develop your winning strategy across countless combinations and character combinations.

⏺ All the Silver!

Includes the complete library of cards and Silver tokens! Mix and match cards from different sets to create your own customized deck!

Silver Amulet: Master the basic strategies of Silver with this core collection of Silver cards.

Silver Bullet: The best defense is a strong offense! These 14 new cards increase aggressive play, allowing players to get in each others' faces. Immediately eliminate any card from your village with the coveted Silver Bullet!

Silver Coin: Clever card play is the core behind this set of 14 cards. Pull off some rather clever card combos and rapidly take the lead from others! Cull your village with ease with cards like Curator.

Silver Dagger: Reverse the direction of play and gift the zombie horde to your opponents. This collection of 14 cards explores cards with powerful swings and effects, such as the Fury who is capable of gifting 50 points to each of your opponents! If you can pull off his request...

Silver Eye: High-Risk-High-Reward is the name of the game in this collection of cards! Use the Illusionist to score negative points! Employ the Mad Bomber and remove any card from the game during final scoring!

Silver Fang: Enter powerful characters such as Odd Maude and Even Steven who cancel effects of odd and even cards respectively! Beware the Tallyman who immediately scores all faceup cards; nobody escapes death or taxes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel® Pentium® D or AMD® Athlon™ 64 X2
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 8600 GT or ATI™ Radeon™ HD 2600XT or better
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ 2 Duo (2.2 GHz) or AMD® Athlon™ 64 X2 (2.6 GHz) or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 240 GT or ATI™ Radeon™ HD 4850 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS X® 10.14 (latest version)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ 2 Duo or Apple® M1
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 8600M GT or ATI™ Radeon™ HD 2600 Pro
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS® 10.14 (latest version)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 or better or Apple® M2 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 650M or ATI™ Radeon™ HD 5670 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
